title: Polystyrene Film FTIR Wavenumber Calibration Reference
description: JCAMP-DX 4.24 infrared transmittance spectrum of a standard polystyrene calibration film across the 1650 to 1550 cm-1 aromatic C=C stretch band.
code:
##TITLE=Polystyrene Film Reference FTIR Spectrum (1650-1550 cm-1)
##JCAMP-DX=4.24
##DATA TYPE=INFRARED SPECTRUM
##ORIGIN=NIST Standard Reference Material 1921b
##OWNER=PUBLIC DOMAIN
##XUNITS=1/CM
##YUNITS=TRANSMITTANCE
##FIRSTX=1650
##LASTX=1550
##NPOINTS=11
##XFACTOR=1
##YFACTOR=0.01
$$ Characteristic 1601 cm-1 aromatic ring stretching band
##XYDATA=(X++(Y..Y))
1650 94 93 91 84 62 28 59 86 92 94 95
##END=

title: Aspirin (Acetylsalicylic Acid) 1H-NMR Chemical Shift Table
description: JCAMP-DX 5.00 proton NMR peak table for acetylsalicylic acid in CDCl3 resolving the acetyl methyl singlet (2.35 ppm), four aromatic protons (7.1-8.1 ppm), and carboxylic acid proton (11.4 ppm).
code:
##TITLE=Aspirin (Acetylsalicylic Acid) 400 MHz 1H-NMR Peak Table
##JCAMP-DX=5.00
##DATA TYPE=NMR PEAK TABLE
##ORIGIN=Organic Structure Elucidation Lab
##OWNER=PUBLIC DOMAIN
##MOLFORM=C9 H8 O4
##XUNITS=PPM
##YUNITS=RELATIVE INTENSITY
##FIRSTX=2.35
##LASTX=11.40
##NPOINTS=6
##XFACTOR=1
##YFACTOR=1
$$ Methyl singlet (2.35), ortho/meta/para aromatic ring (7.12-8.12), COOH (11.40)
##PEAK TABLE=(XY..XY)
2.35, 100.0; 7.12, 34.5; 7.36, 36.2; 7.62, 35.8; 8.12, 33.9; 11.40, 28.0
##END=

title: Caffeine 70 eV Electron-Ionization Mass Spectrum
description: JCAMP-DX 5.00 EI-MS fragmentation spectrum of caffeine (C8H10N4O2) displaying the molecular ion base peak at m/z 194, retro-Diels-Alder fragment at m/z 109, and diagnostic ions at m/z 82, 67, and 55.
code:
##TITLE=Caffeine 70 eV Electron-Ionization Mass Spectrum
##JCAMP-DX=5.00
##DATA TYPE=MASS SPECTRUM
##ORIGIN=NIST/EPA/NIH Mass Spectral Reference
##OWNER=PUBLIC DOMAIN
##MOLFORM=C8 H10 N4 O2
##XUNITS=M/Z
##YUNITS=RELATIVE ABUNDANCE
##FIRSTX=42
##LASTX=195
##NPOINTS=10
##XFACTOR=1
##YFACTOR=1
$$ Molecular ion M+ at m/z 194 (100%), M-CH3NCO at m/z 109 (66%), imidazole ring at m/z 82
##PEAK TABLE=(XY..XY)
42, 18.5; 55, 34.2; 67, 29.8; 82, 39.4; 109, 66.1; 137, 12.4; 165, 6.8; 193, 9.2; 194, 100.0; 195, 10.6
##END=

title: Benzaldehyde Multi-Block LINK Spectral Archive (IR + MS + UV-Vis)
